Apply machine learning and other artificial intelligence techniques to develop practical solutions for business use cases. Implement analytical solutions into products and service offerings so insights can be operationalized at scale. Collaborate with technical and business partners to validate results, improve data quality, and support adoption. Document assumptions, model logic, and implementation details to support maintainability and reuse. Win as one team by sharing insights early, aligning with stakeholders, and collaborating across data, engineering, and business functions. Build solutions with Palantir Foundry and related analytics workflows in a way that supports secure, scalable delivery and long-term reuse. What are we looking for? University degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. 8 years of suggested minimum experience in AI, data science, analytics engineering, or a related field. Strong experience working on complex projects involving data modeling, data mining, pattern analysis, and data visualization. Hands-on experience applying machine learning or other artificial intelligence techniques to business problems. Experience with Palantir Foundry and using enterprise data platforms to support analysis and solution delivery. Ability to translate business requirements into technical approaches and communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Experience working with large datasets, data quality considerations, and iterative solution development. Strong collaboration, organization, and problem-solving skills. Nice to have Experience supporting Finance, commercial analytics, or Lead Gen use cases. Experience implementing AI solutions into products and service offerings. Exposure to production analytics workflows, model evaluation, or solution lifecycle improvement. Experience working in fast-moving, cross-functional environments where priorities can evolve. What do we offer? Comprehensive benefits package. Opportunities for professional growth and development. Supportive and inclusive work environment. Commitment to work-life balance and employee well-being. Engagement in meaningful projects that make a difference.
